hub.title: Emoji Meanings: What {n} Popular Emoji Mean
hub.lede: What {n} of the most-used emoji mean, by Unicode group. Tap Copy to copy an emoji, or open one for its official name, code point, the year it was added and its skin-tone and gender forms.
hub.description: What {n} popular emoji mean, with official Unicode names, code points, the year each was added and one-tap copy: 😂 ❤️ 😭 💀 🥺 🙏 🔥 and more.
about: Each emoji has an official short name and keywords from the Unicode Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR), translated by Unicode's contributors for every language shown here. The groups, the order and the emoji version come from Unicode's emoji-test.txt.
The sentence on what people use an emoji for is written by cv.cm, not by Unicode. Emoji are shown in your device's own emoji font, so they look a little different on each phone or computer.

faq.a: {n} of the most-used emoji: the top of Unicode's published emoji frequency ranking without country flags, plus a few popular emoji added since 2018, which that count ranks too low because they are newer.

faq.q: How do I copy an emoji?
faq.a: Press Copy next to the emoji, then paste it into a message, a post or a document. The emoji itself is copied as text, so it shows in the font of wherever you paste it.

faq.q: Why does an emoji look different on my phone?
faq.a: Unicode defines what each emoji is (its code point and name), and each company (Apple, Google, Samsung, Microsoft and others) draws its own pictures. The meaning is the same; the drawing differs.
